# Español con amigos

> Free Spanish vocabulary and grammar lessons from A1 to C2, with Russian and English explanations, examples, flashcards, and quizzes.

The pages below are readable without JavaScript. Interactive lessons are linked from each topic page.

## Levels

- [A1 — Начальный](https://espanolconamigos.com/learn/ru/a1/index.html): Grammar and vocabulary topics for A1.
- [A2 — Элементарный](https://espanolconamigos.com/learn/ru/a2/index.html): Grammar and vocabulary topics for A2.
- [B1 — Средний](https://espanolconamigos.com/learn/ru/b1/index.html): Grammar and vocabulary topics for B1.
- [B2 — Выше среднего](https://espanolconamigos.com/learn/ru/b2/index.html): Grammar and vocabulary topics for B2.
- [C1 — Продвинутый](https://espanolconamigos.com/learn/ru/c1/index.html): Grammar and vocabulary topics for C1.
- [C2 — В совершенстве](https://espanolconamigos.com/learn/ru/c2/index.html): Grammar and vocabulary topics for C2.

## English

- [All topics in English](https://espanolconamigos.com/learn/en/index.html): English explanations and translations.

## Full content

- [Complete text](https://espanolconamigos.com/llms-full.txt): All vocabulary and grammar content in Markdown.
